headline: 1 killed, 10 injured as bus carrying Russian RNPP workers collides with truck
summary: A truck helper died and seven Russian citizens were among the injured in a head-on collision on the Bonpara-Hatikumrul highway in Natore.
details: A truck helper was killed and 10 others, including seven Russian workers from the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant, were injured in a head-on collision in Natore's Gurudaspur upazila.
The deceased has been identified as 18-year-old Md Rimon Hossain, a truck helper from the Hoybatpur area of Natore Sadar upazila, according to fire officials.
The accident occurred around 9:45 pm in the Noyabazar area on the Bonpara-Hatikumrul highway when a Rooppur-bound bus carrying the Russian workers collided with an onion-laden truck.
Rescue operations were carried out by the fire service, and the injured were taken to the Gurudaspur Upazila Health Complex for treatment.
Among the injured are seven Russian citizens and one Bangladeshi worker.
The collision caused vehicular movement on the Bonpara-Hatikumrul highway to be halted for approximately one hour following the incident.
caption:
A tragic head-on collision in Natore has left one dead and several Russian nuclear power plant workers injured.

A truck helper was killed and 10 others, including seven Russian workers from the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant, were injured in a head-on collision in Natore's Gurudaspur upazila.

The deceased has been identified as 18-year-old Md Rimon Hossain, a truck helper from the Hoybatpur area of Natore Sadar upazila, according to fire officials.

The accident occurred around 9:45 pm in the Noyabazar area on the Bonpara-Hatikumrul highway when a Rooppur-bound bus carrying the Russian workers collided with an onion-laden truck.

Rescue operations were carried out by the fire service, and the injured were taken to the Gurudaspur Upazila Health Complex for treatment.

Among the injured are seven Russian citizens and one Bangladeshi worker.

The collision caused vehicular movement on the Bonpara-Hatikumrul highway to be halted for approximately one hour following the incident.

headline_marked: Tragedy in pond: [[3 children die]] while bathing
headline: Tragedy in pond: 3 children die while bathing
summary: The victims include a pair of siblings, highlighting the danger of unsupervised swimming in rural ponds.
details: Three children drowned in a pond while bathing. Among the victims were a brother and sister.
The incident occurred in a rural area, leading to the deaths of three young children.
Local residents and authorities have gathered at the scene to manage the situation and recover the bodies.
The tragedy has left the community in shock as families mourn the loss of their children.
